title: Most news feeds treat you like a demographic, not a person.
body:
We have all felt the frustration of a feed that shows us things we do not care about. The standard approach for most apps is to guess what you like based on what people similar to you have clicked. It is a logic built on broad assumptions rather than your actual interests.

At Headlinne, we built our recommendation engine differently. Instead of looking at groups, the system pays attention to the specific signals you give it. When you read an article to the end, or skip a topic entirely, the AI learns from those actions. It is not trying to predict your next click to keep you scrolling forever. It is trying to understand the specific subjects and perspectives that genuinely matter to you today.

This creates a feedback loop that gets smarter the more you use it. You are not a data point in a generic category. You are an individual with changing interests. Your news feed should reflect that.
cta: You can see how this feels in practice at HEADLINNE.com.
